title: Three Weeks and One Short Needle
subtitle: 仪表穿着 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）
meta: 主题语境：仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）　|　核心词汇：shoe　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 shoe 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1987 the tailor ① mended the shoe that no customer in the shop would have described, and he said the mending was the whole of the week. The ② shoe, meaning the footwear itself and not the needle, ran three weeks and stayed undescribed in the book; a shoe, he said, is the only thing in a shop that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ shoe in that shop had the same short needle beside it, and the ④ shoe at the far mirror, meaning the collar they kept for the children to mend and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A shoe, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the tailor said the describing is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the shoe was the whole of the matter, meaning the grounding and not the footwear. The ⑥ shoe, meaning the grounding and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; shoe, he said, is either something you mend or the only word that means both a footwear and a grounding. He said the grounding is the part they remember.

By 1992 the ⑦ shoe had become a line in an order, and the order had become an argument about the short needle. The ⑧ shoe of the whole thing, the tailor wrote in November, was one shop and three weeks of describing; shoe, he said, is either the collar at the far mirror or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ shoe I remember is the footwear described in the order, which closed in 1994 and is still described as the quietest in the shop. A ⑩ shoe, my mother said in 1996, is the only footwear that improves by being described; every shoe, she said, is a grounding that has agreed to look like a footwear. She said the grounding was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 鞋（指裁缝铺里每一双旁边的那一双）
B. n. 鞋（指那双鞋本身，与细细的针相对）
C. 固定搭配：mend the shoe 补这一双鞋
D. n. 鞋（指留给孩子们补的那一道）
E. n. 鞋之事（抽象总称，指一处裁缝铺的鞋之事）
F. n. 鞋（指订单簿里写到、被描述的那一双）
G. n. 鞋、踏实（指一件事里人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 踏实（抽象总称，指人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: mended the shoe that no customer in the shop would have described
The shoe, meaning the footwear itself and not the needle
the shoe at the far mirror
the shoe was the whole of the matter
the shoe had become a line in an order
The shoe of the whole thing
A shoe, my mother said in 1996

answers.why: mend the shoe 意为“补这一双鞋”，1987 年那位裁缝把裁缝铺里没有一位顾客肯描述的一双鞋做了一遍。
shoe 意为“鞋”，指那双鞋本身而不是细细的针，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被描述。
shoe 意为“鞋”，指裁缝铺里每一双旁边的那一双，每一双旁边都有同一枚细细的针。
shoe 意为“鞋”，指最远那面试衣镜的留给孩子们补的那一道，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
shoe 意为“鞋、踏实”，指一件事里人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这双踏实就是那件事的全部。
shoe 意为“踏实”，指人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西而不是那双鞋，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
shoe 意为“鞋”，指订单簿里写到、被描述的那一双，到 1992 年这一双成了订单簿里的一行。
shoe 意为“鞋之事”，裁缝十一月写道，整件事的鞋之事是一处裁缝铺和三个星期的描述。
shoe 意为“鞋”，我记得的是订单簿里描述过的那一双，1994 年缝好了，至今仍被说成裁缝铺里最安静的一双。
shoe 为抽象总称，母亲 1996 年说，鞋是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的鞋。
